plain_english: By the individual means and its rule, this is determined for those who desire the supreme abode.
sanskrit_cite: āṇavena vidhinā paradhāma prepsatāmatha nirūpyata etat

plain_english: When conceptualization is purified and the desired thing is unopposed, attainment of enjoyment and liberation is certain.
sanskrit_cite: vikalpasyaiva saṃskāre jāte niṣpratiyogini abhīṣṭe vastuni prāptirniścitā bhogamokṣayoḥ

plain_english: Conceptualization becomes very stable when it arises from one's own self-freedom, without dependence on other means.
sanskrit_cite: vikalpaḥ kasyacitsvātmasvātantryādeva susthiraḥ upāyāntarasāpekṣyaviyogenaiva jāyate

plain_english: For someone, conceptualization directed toward self-purification is said to depend on other means, according to the previous rule.
sanskrit_cite: kasyacittu vikalpo@sau svātmasaṃskaraṇaṃ prati upāyāntarasāpekṣastatroktaḥ pūrvako vidhiḥ

plain_english: Conceptualization is called the nature of pure consciousness; though situated, it still joins freedom for the limited self.
sanskrit_cite: vikalpo nāma cinmātrasvabhāvo yadyapi sthitaḥ tathāpi niścayātmāsāvaṇoḥ svātantryayojakaḥ

plain_english: Certainty is manifold, and the means there are distinct; they are spoken of by the word anu according to far and near.
sanskrit_cite: niścayo bahudhā caiṣa tatropāyāśca bhedinaḥ aṇuśabdena te coktā dūrāntikavibhedataḥ

plain_english: Ultimate truth shines in intellect, breath, body, and cognizer, even in what is non-ultimate.
sanskrit_cite: tatra buddhau tathā prāṇe dehe cāpi pramātari apāramārthike@pyasmin paramārthaḥ prakāśate

plain_english: Because it is non-different from pure consciousness light, that body of inert and conscious is doubled through freedom.
sanskrit_cite: yataḥ prakāśāccinmātrāt prāṇādyavyatirekavat tasyaiva tu svatantratvāddviguṇaṃ jaḍacidvapuḥ

plain_english: In Traishirasa it is said to the goddess: the individual soul is Shiva's power, situated everywhere.
sanskrit_cite: uktaṃ traiśirase caitaddevyai candrārdhamaulinā jīvaḥ śaktiḥ śivasyaiva sarvatraiva sthitāpi sā

plain_english: Established in realization of one's own nature, supreme through unfolding knowledge, consciousness-nature is true through conception of freedom's expansion.
sanskrit_cite: svarūpapratyaye rūḍhā jñānasyonmīlanātparā tasya cidrūpatāṃ satyāṃ svātantryollāsakalpanāt

plain_english: There, hiding duality by seeing the inert-self portion, one may become non-dual by the view of freedom, like a face in a mirror.
sanskrit_cite: paśyañjaḍātmatābhāgaṃ tirodhāyādvayo bhavet tatra svātantryadṛṣṭyā vā darpaṇe mukhabimbavat

plain_english: Pure own consciousness is determined as that nature, distinct from intellect, breath, and the rest, by force.
sanskrit_cite: viśuddhaṃ nijacaitanyaṃ niścinotyatadātmakam buddhiprāṇādito bhinnaṃ caitanyaṃ niścitaṃ balāt

plain_english: From purity alone arises the non-difference of world-form with truth, since mutual difference would divide it.
sanskrit_cite: satyatastadabhinnaṃ syāttasyānyonyavibhedataḥ viśvarūpāvibheditvaṃ śuddhatvādeva jāyate

plain_english: Even if forms conflict, all being remains within consciousness rather than resting otherwise in intellect.
sanskrit_cite: niṣṭhitaikasphuranmūrtermūrtyantaravirodhataḥ antaḥ saṃvidi satsarvaṃ yadyapyaparathā dhiyi

plain_english: Even so, in this doubt-free state there is no doubt without that support.
sanskrit_cite: prāṇe dehe@thavā kasmātsaṃkrāmetkena vā katham tathāpi nirvikalpe@sminvikalpo nāsti taṃ vinā

plain_english: But certainty in intellect, breath, and body comes directly through supreme lordship.
sanskrit_cite: dṛṣṭe@pyadṛṣṭakalpatvaṃ vikalpena tu niścayaḥ buddhiprāṇaśarīreṣu pārameśvaryamañjasā

plain_english: What is imagined has void-form, but imagining does not occur in the knower; there intellect is meditation and breath is utterance.
sanskrit_cite: vikalpyaṃ śūnyarūpe na pramātari vikalpanam buddhirdhyānamayī tatra prāṇa uccāraṇātmakaḥ

plain_english: Utterance includes five breath functions from prana to vyana, and the first would be supreme utterance-natured.
sanskrit_cite: uccāraṇaṃ ca prāṇādyā vyānāntāḥ pañca vṛttayaḥ ādyā tu prāṇanābhikhyāparoccārātmikā bhavet

plain_english: The body is established as a mass of sense objects; there the meditation-made supreme is spoken here.
sanskrit_cite: śarīrasyākṣaviṣayaitatpiṇḍatvena saṃsthitiḥ tatra dhyānamayaṃ tāvadanuttaramihocyate

plain_english: The independent consciousness-natured light situated in the heart is all-principle-made, as said in the trishira doctrine.
sanskrit_cite: yaḥ prakāśaḥ svatantro@yaṃ citsvabhāvo hṛdi sthitaḥ sarvatattvamayaḥ proktametacca triśiromate

plain_english: The principle-knower sees within the heart a banana-sheath-shaped form with outer, inner, and middle, like a flower.
sanskrit_cite: kadalīsaṃpuṭākāraṃ sabāhyābhyantarāntaram īkṣate hṛdayāntaḥsthaṃ tatpuṣpamiva tattvavit

plain_english: There one should meditate with unwavering mind on the conjunction of moon, sun, and fire; that meditation agitation makes great Bhairava consume offerings.
sanskrit_cite: somasūryāgnisaṃghaṭṭaṃ tatra dhyāyedananyadhīḥ taddhyānāraṇisaṃkṣobhānmahābhairavahavyabhuk

plain_english: Blazing in the great heart-basin, fullness would arise for that power-possessor with expanded power and Bhairava radiance.
sanskrit_cite: hṛdayākhye mahākuṇḍe jājvalan sphītatāṃ vrajet tasya śaktimataḥ sphītaśakterbhairavatejasaḥ

plain_english: One should contemplate knower, knowing, and known by abode non-difference; the fire, sun, and moon powers become that same triad.
sanskrit_cite: mātṛmānaprameyākhyaṃ dhāmābhedena bhāvayet vahnyarkasomaśaktīnāṃ tadeva tritayaṃ bhavet

plain_english: The supreme, supreme-and-lower, and lower goddesses are always arisen; through creation, preservation, and dissolution they are individually threefold.
sanskrit_cite: parā parāparā ceyamaparā ca sadoditā sṛṣṭisaṃsthitisaṃhāraistāsāṃ pratyekatastridhā

plain_english: The fourth unlimited form of them is unimagined; thus twelve goddesses are situated like sun discs.
sanskrit_cite: caturthaṃ cānavacchinnaṃ rūpamāsāmakalpitam evaṃ dvādaśa tā devyaḥ sūryabimbavadāsthitāḥ

plain_english: Of each of them, fire, sun, moon, and their peace-radiance is this supreme wheel, from heart and eyes and so on.
sanskrit_cite: ekaikamāsāṃ vahnyarkasomatacchāntibhāsanam etadānuttaraṃ cakraṃ hṛdayāccakṣurādibhiḥ

plain_english: It goes indeed through voids in each object domain; by that wheel radiance there in meaning, by creation, preservation, and dissolution order.
sanskrit_cite: vyomabhirniḥsaratyeva tattadviṣayagocare taccakrabhābhistatrārthe sṛṣṭisthitilayakramāt

plain_english: The moon-sun-fire radiance-nature form stands together; thus in sound and other objects, by the ear and other void paths.
sanskrit_cite: somasūryāgnibhāsātma rūpaṃ samavatiṣṭhate evaṃ śabdādiviṣaye śrotrādivyomavartmanā

plain_english: By this falling wheel one should contemplate identity; by this ordered union, wherever that falls.
sanskrit_cite: cakreṇānena patatā tādātmyaṃ paribhāvayet anena kramayogena yatra yatra patatyadaḥ

plain_english: The all-natured wheel, like each all-earthly king, thus dissolves the world path layer effortlessly.
sanskrit_cite: cakraṃ sarvātmakaṃ tattatsārvabhaumamahīśavat itthaṃ viśvādhvapaṭalamayatnenaiva līyate

plain_english: In the Bhairava great wheel surrounded by consciousness, then by impression only, even the world is destroyed.
sanskrit_cite: bhairavīyamahācakre saṃvittiparivārite tataḥ saṃskāramātreṇa viśvasyāpi parikṣaye

plain_english: By own self rising, one should meditate the great revolving wheel; then by that burnable dissolution and that impression destruction.
sanskrit_cite: svātmocchalattayā bhrāmyaccakraṃ saṃcintayenmahat tatastaddāhyavilayāt tatsaṃskāraparikṣayāt

plain_english: One should contemplate the calming wheel; then peaceful, then peace; by this meditation union the world dissolves in the wheel.
sanskrit_cite: praśāmyadbhāvayeccakraṃ tataḥ śāntaṃ tataḥ śamam anena dhyānayogena viśvaṃ cakre vilīyate

plain_english: In that consciousness, then consciousness-dissolved meaning alone shines; by consciousness nature, then again creation, which is conscious great lady.
sanskrit_cite: tatsaṃvidi tataḥ saṃvidvilīnārthaiva bhāsate citsvābhāvyāt tato bhūyaḥ sṛṣṭiryaccinmaheśvarī

plain_english: Thus every moment, dissolving and emitting the world in own consciousness, then again one should go to perpetual Bhairava state.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ viśvaṃ svasaṃvidi vilāpayan visṛjaṃśca tato bhūyaḥ śaśvadbhairavatāṃ vrajet

plain_english: Thus, from trishula onward, by the four-five-ara sequence up to fifty ara, the yogi should visualize the wheel.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ triśūlāt prabhṛti catuṣpañcārakakramāt pañcāśadaraparyantaṃ cakraṃ yogī vibhāvayet

plain_english: Or the sixty-four-hundred-ara wheel, or the thousand-ara wheel, or the countless-thousand-ara wheel, the one of undivided mind should meditate.
sanskrit_cite: catuṣṣaṣṭiśatāraṃ vā sahasrāramathāpi vā asaṃkhyārasahasraṃ vā cakraṃ dhyāyedananyadhīḥ

plain_english: Of the great lord of consciousness, of the god of arising consciousness, there is no calculation at all of the great lord of world-power.
sanskrit_cite: saṃvinnāthasya mahato devasyollāsisaṃvidaḥ naivāsti kācitkalanā viśvaśaktermaheśituḥ

plain_english: His powers are the whole world; the power-holder is the great lord. Thus, in the auspicious scripture, Sri Srikantha explained.
sanskrit_cite: śaktayo@sya jagat kṛtsnaṃ śaktimāṃstu maheśvaraḥ iti māṅgalaśāstre tu śrīśrīkaṇṭho nyarūpayat

plain_english: Thus this first-means-form meditation was explained by Sri Shambhunatha; to me, Sri Sumatiprabhu was pleased to him.
sanskrit_cite: ityetat prathamopāyarūpaṃ dhyānaṃ nyarūpayat śrīśaṃbhunātho me tuṣṭastasmai śrīsumatiprabhuḥ

plain_english: By this same direction, other meditations too should be resorted to, those that reach the burden of the unexcelled means without sequence.
sanskrit_cite: anayaiva diśānyāni dhyānānyapi samāśrayet anuttaropāyadhurāṃ yānyāyānti kramaṃ vinā

plain_english: Now, breath's function, beginning with prana, is explained; by that means we speak of unexcelled expansion.
sanskrit_cite: atha prāṇasya yā vṛttiḥ prāṇanādyā nirūpitā tadupāyatayā brūmo@nuttarapravikāsanam

plain_english: Situated formerly in the heart in own bliss, in the measure of knower and object, from rest in mere void, one should visualize the blissless.
sanskrit_cite: nijānande pramātraṃśamātre hṛdi purā sthitaḥ śūnyatāmātraviśrānternirānandaṃ vibhāvayet

plain_english: At breath rising, in the object, one should visualize supreme bliss; there, freed by filling endless object parts with apana.
sanskrit_cite: prāṇodaye prameye tu parānandaṃ vibhāvayet tatrānantaprameyāṃśapūraṇāpānanirvṛtaḥ

plain_english: Standing in supreme bliss, adorned by the apana moon, then one is freed by the single contact of endless shining objects.
sanskrit_cite: parānandagatastiṣṭhedapānaśaśiśobhitaḥ tato@nantasphuranmeyasaṃghaṭṭaikāntanirvṛtaḥ

plain_english: Having reached the samana level, one becomes full of brahma bliss; then also one is intent on swallowing the mass of knower-known calculation.
sanskrit_cite: samānabhūmimāgatya brahmānandamayo bhavet tato@pi mānameyaughakalanāgrāsatatparaḥ

plain_english: Resting in udana fire, one should visualize great bliss; there, having reached rest, one becomes calm in that great flame.
sanskrit_cite: udānavahnau viśrānto mahānandaṃ vibhāvayat tatra viśrāntimabhyetya śāmyatyasminmahārciṣi

plain_english: Then indeed consciousness-bliss, not strengthened by the insentient, is the great pervasion free from support.
sanskrit_cite: nirupādhirmahāvyāptirvyānākhyopādhivarjitā tadā khalu cidānando yo jaḍānupabṛṃhitaḥ

plain_english: Here no divided abiding of insentient form exists; where shining appears from all sides, no separation exists.
sanskrit_cite: nahyatra saṃsthitiḥ kāpi vibhaktā jaḍarūpiṇaḥ yatra ko@pi vyavacchedo nāsti yadviśvataḥ sphurat

plain_english: Unstruck awareness, strengthened by supreme nectar, is where meditations have no primary connection.
sanskrit_cite: yadanāhatasaṃvitti paramāmṛtabṛṃhitam yatrāsti bhāvanādīnāṃ na mukhyā kāpi saṃgatiḥ

plain_english: That world-bliss Shambhu gives us; there rest is to be taken by heart-utterance.
sanskrit_cite: tadeva jagadānandamasmabhyaṃ śaṃbhurūcivān tatra viśrāntirādheyā hṛdayoccārayogataḥ

plain_english: That right rest there is the supreme abiding, even in heart and other one-natured places, in one's own abode.
sanskrit_cite: yā tatra samyagviśrāntiḥ sānuttaramayī sthitiḥ ityetaddhṛdayādyekasvabhāve@pi svadhāmani

plain_english: The sixfold breath-born form is then called pervasion by use of the breath staff, equalizing prior and later.
sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭprāṇoccārajaṃ rūpamatha vyāptyā taducyate prāṇadaṇḍaprayogena pūrvāparasamīkṛteḥ

plain_english: Dwell in the four-petaled lotus hanging palace; having crossed the trident ground, reach the three-channel-joined state.
sanskrit_cite: catuṣkikāmbujālambilambikāsaudhamāśrayet triśūlabhūmiṃ krāntvāto nāḍitritayasaṅgatām

plain_english: When will, knowledge, action, and power are equal, the wise one enters one expanding, more-contracted, radiant state.
sanskrit_cite: icchājñānakriyāśaktisamatve praviśet sudhīḥ ekāṃ vikāsinīṃ bhūyastvasaṃkocāṃ vikasvarām

plain_english: Dwell on the brow-point sound-end power staircase; there on the upward coiled ground a beautiful throb arises.
sanskrit_cite: śrayedbhrūbindunādāntaśaktisopānamālikām tatrordhvakuṇḍalībhūmau spandanodarasundaraḥ

plain_english: Emission rests there in the fish-belly state, as a she-donkey or mare rests in its own abode, a temple of bliss.
sanskrit_cite: visargastatra viśrāmyenmatsyodaradaśājuṣi rāsabhī vaḍavā yadvatsvadhāmānandamandiram

plain_english: Entering the expansion-contraction in the heart, one rejoices in the momentary full crowd of absorbed and emitted states.
sanskrit_cite: vikāsasaṃkocamayaṃ praviśya hṛdi hṛṣyati tadvanmuhurlīnasṛṣṭabhāvavrātasunirbharām

plain_english: Dwell in the expansion-contraction-rooted Bhairava couple, the unified great root trident emission, in the heart.
sanskrit_cite: śrayedvikāsasaṃkocarūḍhabhairavayāmalām ekīkṛtamahāmūlaśūlavaisargike hṛdi

plain_english: Here rest in the supreme, through all-filling union, is established as world-entry by that full activity alone.
sanskrit_cite: parasminneti viśrāntiṃ sarvāpūraṇayogataḥ atra tatpūrṇavṛttyaiva viśvāveśamayaṃ sthitam

plain_english: In supreme reflection free from prior activity, let the self-rest of light be seen as I-am.
sanskrit_cite: prakāśasyātmaviśrāntāvahamityeva dṛśyatām anuttaravimarśe prāgvyāpārādivivarjite

plain_english: The supreme I-maker of consciousness reflection first shines; then, by effort, he becomes the twelve-part self.
sanskrit_cite: cidvimarśaparāhaṃkṛt prathamollāsinī sphuret tata udyogasaktena sa dvādaśakalātmanā

plain_english: Let the sun illuminate being, then fill and contemplate; then the sixteen-part moon slowly devours emission.
sanskrit_cite: sūryeṇābhāsayedbhāvaṃ pūrayedatha carcayet athenduḥ ṣoḍaśakalo visargagrāsamantharaḥ

plain_english: The reviving nectar is emitted into consciousness fire, throbbing through the subtle channel of will, knowledge, and action powers.
sanskrit_cite: saṃjīvanyamṛtaṃ bodhavahnau visṛjati sphuran icchājñānakriyāśaktisūkṣmarandhrasrugagragam

plain_english: That divine nectar, satisfying among consciousness goddesses, is emission nectar thus far in the fire of offering called consciousness.
sanskrit_cite: tadevama[tada]mṛtaṃ divyaṃ saṃviddevīṣu tarpakam visargāmṛtametāvad bodhākhye hutabhojini

plain_english: If all becomes emitted and offered, the sixfold path circle arises; because of the supreme lord, emission and clan leader agitation expand from ka to ha as reality path.
sanskrit_cite: visṛṣṭaṃ cedbhavetsarvaṃ hutaṃ ṣoḍhādhvamaṇḍalam yato@nuttaranāthasya visargaḥ kulanāyikā tatkṣobhaḥ kādihāntaṃ tatprasarastattvapaddhatiḥ

plain_english: Thus aṃ, accompanied by the clan mistress, indeed makes clan lordship supreme; the world is called that which is filled by emission separation.
sanskrit_cite: aṃa iti kuleśvaryā sahito hi kuleśitā paro visargaviśleṣastanmayaṃ viśvamucyate

plain_english: Thus worship, offer, and meditate upon this reviving phase filled with consciousness, breath, quality, body, and outer substance.
sanskrit_cite: vitprāṇaguṇadehāntarbahirdravyamayīmimām arcayejjuhuyāddhyāyeditthaṃ saṃjīvanīṃ kalām

plain_english: Situated with two bliss channels pulsing attentively, he approaches this ground of emission flow and palace.
sanskrit_cite: ānandanāḍīyugalaspandanāvahitau sthitaḥ enāṃ visarganiḥṣyandasaudhabhūmiṃ prapadyate

plain_english: In shakti agitation, clan entry, pervasion at tips of all channels, and all-self contraction, the wise one enters the heart.
sanskrit_cite: śākte kṣobhe kulāveśe sarvanāḍyagragocare vyāptau sarvātmasaṃkoce hṛdayaṃ praviśetsudhīḥ

plain_english: From mutual friction of moon and sun phase nets, in the fire-moon abode, emission bliss opens.
sanskrit_cite: somasūryakalājālaparasparanigharṣataḥ agnīṣomātmake dhāmni visargānanda unmiṣet

plain_english: Enough of secret talk; this is hidden by its own nature. Resting there in the yogini-heart, the wise one becomes accomplished.
sanskrit_cite: alaṃ rahasyakathayā guptametatsvabhāvataḥ yoginīhṛdayaṃ tatra viśrāntaḥ syātkṛtī budhaḥ

plain_english: Grown familiar in the conduct of rejecting, accepting, and disregarding, one sees the universe from non-dual conduct, out of consciousness-relish.
sanskrit_cite: hānādānatiraskāravṛttau rūḍhimupāgataḥ abhedavṛttitaḥ paśyedviśvaṃ citicamatkṛteḥ

plain_english: Abandoning prayer born of neediness in outer and inner self, reaching cessation-bliss in sky-form, one resorts to the blossomed sound-stage.
sanskrit_cite: arthakriyārthitādainyaṃ tyaktvā bāhyāntarātmani kharūpe nirvṛtiṃ prāpya phullāṃ nādadaśāṃ śrayet

plain_english: With the mouth within, rightly bloom consciousness forth; the lofty imperishable wheel of consciousness, non-different from the knowable, becomes thence.
sanskrit_cite: vaktramantastayā samyak saṃvidaḥ pravikāsayet saṃvidakṣamaruccakraṃ jñeyābhinnaṃ tato bhavet

plain_english: That knowable is dissolved away by the consciousness-named fire; dissolved, it dissolves in the power-fire of the triangle here.
sanskrit_cite: tajjñeyaṃ saṃvidākhyena vahninā pravilīyate vilīnaṃ tat trikoṇe@smiñśaktivahnau vilīyate

plain_english: There, well at peace in noble perception-drop-being, rested in the withdrawal seed, the yogi becomes supreme-measured.
sanskrit_cite: tatra saṃvedanodārabindusattāsunirvṛtaḥ saṃhārabījaviśrānto yogī paramayo bhavet

plain_english: In inner and outer both, beautiful beyond common and uncommon, the self of consciousness-throb and three powers holds contraction and expansion.
sanskrit_cite: antarbāhye dvaye vāpi sāmānyetarasundaraḥ saṃvitspandastriśaktyātmā saṃkocapravikāsavān

plain_english: Even uncontracted expansion, from its shining forth thus, aimed within with outward gaze, reaches the supreme state.
sanskrit_cite: asaṃkocavikāso@pi tadābhāsanatastathā antarlakṣyo bahirdṛṣṭiḥ paramaṃ padamaśnute

plain_english: Then in unmeasured freedom, the wondrous-purpose-act-form reflecting, the distinct throb named eagerness stirs.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ svātantryanirmeye vicitrārthakriyākṛti vimarśanaṃ viśeṣākhyaḥ spanda aunmukhyasaṃjñitaḥ

plain_english: There, coming to rest whose vigor in the mantra-circle, since peace and the powers come from identity with each respective form.
sanskrit_cite: tatra viśrāntimāgacchedyadvīryaṃ mantramaṇḍale śāntyādisiddhayastattadrūpatādātmyato yataḥ

plain_english: Divine is this eye-multitude named awareness-freedom; unclosed, he makes just this world self-formed.
sanskrit_cite: divyo yaścākṣasaṃgho@yaṃ bodhasvātantryasaṃjñakaḥ so@nimīlita evaitat kuryātsvātmamayaṃ jagat

plain_english: With all activities dissolved in union of great venture, heaped in the flood of own rays, having become full, he stands.
sanskrit_cite: mahāsāhasasaṃyogavilīnākhilavṛttikaḥ puñjībhūte svaraśmyoghe nirbharībhūya tiṣṭhati

plain_english: There, one who does not think the unthinkable goes as clear seer to consciousness, whose sparks are the single cause of burning samsara to ash.
sanskrit_cite: akiciccintakastatra spaṣṭadṛgyāti saṃvidam yadvisphuliṅgāḥ saṃsārabhasmadāhaikahetavaḥ

plain_english: That was said by the supreme lord in the Trishira Bhairava Agama: listen, goddess, I will declare entry into the mantra plane.
sanskrit_cite: taduktaṃ parameśena triśirobhairavāgame śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi mantrabhūmyāṃ praveśanam

plain_english: The upward movement of the middle channel is marked by attaining its nature, beyond the end of the emission word, determined at the extreme limit.
sanskrit_cite: madhyanāḍyordhvagamanaṃ taddharmaprāptilakṣaṇam visargāntapadātītaṃ prāntakoṭinirūpitam

plain_english: By blocking the downward flow and avoiding the upward throw, it gives rise to great light, knowledge, and manifestation.
sanskrit_cite: adhaḥpravāhasaṃrodhādūrdhvakṣepavivarjanāt mahāprakāśamudayajñānavyaktipradāyakam

plain_english: Having experienced the supreme abode, by measure-activity one may enter the city-body; that waveless descended single activity is shiva-natured.
sanskrit_cite: anubhūya pare dhāmni mātrāvṛttyā puraṃ viśet nistaraṅgāvatīrṇā sā vṛttirekā śivātmikā

plain_english: Radiant with doubled six wheels, standing there one should examine void, void, standing in void; by the void-dweller one should enter.
sanskrit_cite: catuṣṣaḍdvirdviguṇitacakraṣaṭkasamujjvalā tatsthaṃ [tstho] vicārayet khaṃ khaṃ khasthaṃ khasthena saṃviśet

plain_english: Having abandoned void, void, having mounted the void, standing in void one utters void thus; by authority of dwelling in void, rays stand in the word.
sanskrit_cite: khaṃ khaṃ tyaktvā khamāruhya khasthaṃ khaṃ coccarediti khamadhyāsyādhikāreṇa padasthāścinmarīcayaḥ

plain_english: Meditate the inner existing being; standing in being, desireless toward being, having blocked the movements of being and nonbeing, one is the seer of blocking being and nonbeing.
sanskrit_cite: bhāvayedbhāvamantaḥsthaṃ bhāvastho bhāvaniḥspṛhaḥ bhāvābhāvagatī ruddhvā bhāvābhāvāvarodhadṛk

plain_english: The roots of the self-atom family are power, being, consciousness, delight; the three powers, tinged by seer and seen, are free from that.
sanskrit_cite: ātmāṇukulamūlāni śaktirbhūtiścitī ratiḥ śaktitrayaṃ draṣṭṛdṛśyoparaktaṃ tadvivarjitam

plain_english: This void is declared in ten ways as the characteristic of utterance: standing in the abode, standing in the middle of the abode, made into an abode cavity.
sanskrit_cite: etatkhaṃ daśadhā proktamuccāroccāralakṣaṇam dhāmasthaṃ dhāmamadhyasthaṃ dhāmodarapuṭīkṛtam

plain_english: By the abode awaken the abode; make that abode go to the abode's end; by abode movement, the innermost abode end is to be pierced.
sanskrit_cite: dhāmnā tu bodhayeddhāma dhāma dhāmāntagaṃ kuru taddhāma dhāmagatyā tu bhedyaṃ dhāmāntamāntaram

plain_english: By difference, subdifference, and difference, the difference is to be done from the middle; thus the entry means is proclaimed.
sanskrit_cite: bhedopabhedabhedena bhedaḥ kāryastu madhyataḥ iti praveśopāyo@yamāṇavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ

plain_english: The glorious ten-formed rava, spoken by me and also said in the holy Brahmayamala, is seated in the heart by Lord Maheshvara.
sanskrit_cite: śrīmaheśvaranāthena yo hṛtsthena mamoditaḥ śrībrahmayāmale coktaṃ śrīmān rāvo daśātmakaḥ

plain_english: Gross, subtle, supreme, heart-pleasing, throat and palatal, and from everywhere, that lord gives the state of lordship.
sanskrit_cite: sthūlaḥ sūkṣmaḥ paro hṛdyaḥ kaṇṭhyastālavya eva ca sarvataśca vibhuryo@sau vibhutvapadadāyakaḥ

plain_english: The great yogi who conquers rava enters another body and daily obtains supreme pervasion; one should practice him.
sanskrit_cite: jitarāvo mahāyogī saṃkrāmetparadehagaḥ parāṃ ca vindati vyāptiṃ pratyahaṃ hyabhyaseta tam

plain_english: As long as she is in rava, the female rava dissolves from rava; here by meditation and body-based means on the supreme path.
sanskrit_cite: tāvadyāvadarāve sā rāvāllīyeta rāviṇī atra bhāvanayā dehagatopāyaiḥ pare pathi

plain_english: For one desiring distinction, bliss arises before touching fullness; even from that, lightning-strike-like, body-abandoned.
sanskrit_cite: vivikṣoḥ pūrṇatāsparśātprāgānandaḥ prajāyate tato@pi vidyudāpātasadṛśe dehavarjite

plain_english: In the abode, for a moment, from immersion arises clear flooding, like water and dust, from practiced consciousness-body unity loss.
sanskrit_cite: dhāmni kṣaṇaṃ samāveśādudbhavaḥ prasphuṭaṃ plutiḥ jalapāṃsuvadabhyastasaṃviddehaikyahānitaḥ

plain_english: From own force entry and body looseness one obtains trembling; when dissolved, in certainty of body identity within enjoyment.
sanskrit_cite: svabalākramaṇāddehaśaithilyāt kampamāpnuyāt galite dehatādātmyaniścaye@ntarbhukhatvataḥ

plain_english: One sleeps before rooted in consciousness-self; then rooted in true state, consciousness as world-self.
sanskrit_cite: nidrāyate purā yāvanna rūḍhaḥ saṃvidātmani tataḥ satyapade rūḍho viśvātmatvena saṃvidam

plain_english: Knowing, one reels; reeling is great pervasion, remembered; in self nonself conception, indeed true in nonself.
sanskrit_cite: saṃvidan ghūrṇate ghūrṇirmahāvyāptiryataḥ smṛtā ātmanyanātmābhimatau satyāmeva hyanātmani

plain_english: Self-conceit in body etc is bondage; liberation however is its dissolution; in beginning nonself selfhood, dissolved, obtained in own self.
sanskrit_cite: ātmābhimāno dehādau bandho muktistu tallayaḥ ādāvanātmanyātmatve līne labdhe nijātmani

plain_english: In self nonself destruction great pervasion proceeds; bliss, arising, trembling, sleep, and reeling are fivefold.
sanskrit_cite: ātmanyanātmatānāśe mahāvyāptiḥ pravartate ānanda udbhavaḥ kampo nindrā ghūrṇiśca pañcakam

plain_english: Thus said teaching indeed in holy Malinivijayottara, in this shown bliss etc fivefold, when.
sanskrit_cite: ityuktamata eva śrīmālinīvijayottare pradarśite@sminnānandaprabhṛtau pañcake yadā

plain_english: The yogi sometimes forcefully enters the lordship of each wheel, as the body, though pervaded by consciousness, is governed by the all-lord.
sanskrit_cite: yogī viśettadā tattaccakreśatvaṃ haṭhādvrajet yathā sarveśinā bodhenākrāntāpi tanuḥ kvacit

plain_english: Just as the eye can know form, so entry into a wheel somewhere can make someone or something arise.
sanskrit_cite: kiṃcitkartuṃ prabhavati cakṣuṣā rūpasaṃvidam tathaiva cakre kutrāpi praveśātko@pi saṃbhavet

plain_english: The bliss wheel, originating at the fire point and bulb, is called such; tremor, heart-palate, sleep, and whirling are signs, and an upward coil may arise.
sanskrit_cite: ānandacakraṃ vahnyaśri kanda udbhava ucyate kampo hṛttālu nidrā ca ghūrṇiḥ syādūrdhvakuṇḍalī

plain_english: This is clearly stated in the mantra-head doctrine; thus the supreme heart of utterance-rest is shown.
sanskrit_cite: etacca sphuṭamevoktaṃ śrīmantraiśirase mate evaṃ pradarśitoccāraviśrāntihṛdayaṃ param

plain_english: That unmanifest sign, with undivided human, Shiva, and power, is where this universe is known as dissolved within measure.
sanskrit_cite: yattadavyaktaliṅgaṃ nṛśivaśaktyavibhāgavat atra viśvamidaṃ līnamatrāntaḥsthaṃ ca gamyate

plain_english: This is its mark: the clear immersion of full-power Bhairava awareness in the unfolding of the bodily path.
sanskrit_cite: idaṃ tallakṣaṇaṃ pūrṇaśaktibhairavasaṃvidaḥ dehagādhvasamunmeṣe samāveśastu yaḥ sphuṭaḥ

plain_english: He, with the state of covered i-ness unfolding, has this manifest-unmanifest sign, the potency of mantra, ranging from supreme to inferior.
sanskrit_cite: ahantācchāditonmeṣibhāvedaṃbhāvayuk sa ca vyaktāvyaktamidaṃ liṅgaṃ mantravīryaṃ parāparam

plain_english: Human power unfolding is differentiated from Shiva form; that immersion subordinates Shiva i-ness with differentiation.
sanskrit_cite: naraśaktisamunmeṣi śivarūpādvibheditam yannyakkṛtaśivāhantāsamāveśaṃ vibhedavat

plain_english: That manifest sign is a particular throb-form of consciousness; from the manifest arises accomplishment, from manifest-unmanifest duality liberation, and from the unmanifest the first power of the supreme, in this unsurpassed discussion.
sanskrit_cite: viśeṣaspandarūpaṃ tad vyaktaṃ liṅgaṃ cidātmakam vyaktātsiddhiprasavo vyaktāvyaktāddvayaṃ vimokṣaśca avyaktādbalamādyaṃ parasya nānuttare tviyaṃ carcā

plain_english: The manifest human sign, called self, is where the universe is offered; from that dissolved, the unmanifest remains in it.
sanskrit_cite: ātmākhyaṃ yadvyaktaṃ naraliṅgaṃ tatra viśvamarpayataḥ vyaktāvyaktaṃ tasmādgalite tasmiṃstadavyaktam

plain_english: By that, this self sign rests in the supreme unmanifest, full of Shiva-power atom nature; this discussion is not about the unsurpassed abode.
sanskrit_cite: tenātmaliṅgametat parame śivaśaktyaṇusvabhāvamaye avyakte viśrāmyati nānuttaradhāmagā tviyaṃ carcā

plain_english: This threefold distinction of one throb is established in this sign; one devoted to devotion-rest may always stand here.
sanskrit_cite: ekasya spandanasyaiṣā traidhaṃ bhedavyavasthitiḥ atra liṅge sadā tiṣṭhet pūjāviśrāntitatparaḥ

plain_english: The beautiful lingam, heart of the yogini, gives birth to some consciousness through the union of seed and womb.
sanskrit_cite: yoginīhṛdayaṃ liṅgamidamānandasundaram bījayonisamāpattyā sūte kāmapi saṃvidam

plain_english: Here, without effort, all deities dwell in the bliss-filled abode, being of eternally arisen consciousness.
sanskrit_cite: atra prayāsavirahātsarvo@sau devatāgaṇaḥ ānandapūrṇe dhāmnyāste nityoditacidātmakaḥ

plain_english: Here shines the difficult power of Bhairava, with contraction and expansion, and without contraction and expansion.
sanskrit_cite: atra bhairavanāthasya sasaṃkocavikāsikā bhāsate durghaṭā śaktirasaṃkocavikāsinaḥ

plain_english: Sprinkled by the bliss stream of this lingam's union and emission, the very true universe always newly arises.
sanskrit_cite: etalliṅgasamāpattivisargānandadhārayā siktaṃ tadeva sadviśvaṃ śaśvannavanavāyate

plain_english: Here the supreme means is described by sameness alone; even when lamps blaze, why would the sun not shine?
sanskrit_cite: anuttare@bhyupāyo@tra tādrūpyādeva varṇitaḥ jvaliteṣvapi dīpeṣu gharmāṃśuḥ kiṃ na bhāsate

plain_english: In objects, in their enjoyment, and in pain or pleasure arising from them, even without entering them, minds absorbed know the inner joy of activity ceasing.
sanskrit_cite: artheṣu tadbhogavidhau tadutthe duḥkhe sukhe vā galitābhiśaṅkam anāviśanto@pi nimagnacittā jānanti vṛttikṣayasaukhyamantaḥ

plain_english: In the true self, in consciousness greatness, in mind, and in such service, the yogi stands clearly, and that reality full of rays is to be perceived.
sanskrit_cite: satyevātmani citsvabhāvamahasi svānte tathopaktiyāṃ tasmai kurvati tatpracāravivaśe satyakṣavarge@pi ca satsvartheṣu sukhādiṣu sphuṭataraṃ yadbhedavandhyodayaṃ yogī tiṣṭhati pūrṇaraśmivibhavastattattvamācīyatām

plain_english: Thus the recitation method is declared; the instrument is examined, and that was spoken by the supreme lord in the three-headed scripture.
sanskrit_cite: ityuccāravidhiḥ proktaḥ karaṇaṃ pravivicyate taccetthaṃ triśiraḥśāstre parameśena bhāṣitam

plain_english: By grasped, grasper, consciousness, pervasion, abandonment, impulsion, and placement, the instrument is called sevenfold practice preceded by awareness.
sanskrit_cite: grāhyagrāhakacidvyāptityāgākṣepaniveśanaiḥ karaṇaṃ saptadhā prāhurabhyāsaṃ bodhapūrvakam

plain_english: In impulsion preceded by its pervasion, the instrument's self-establishment is to be understood from the guru's mouth, although the instrument is clear.
sanskrit_cite: tadvyāptipūrvamākṣepe karaṇaṃ svapratiṣṭhatā guruvaktrācca boddhavyaṃ karaṇaṃ yadyapi sphuṭam

plain_english: Yet for protection of scripture, it will be described before that: this recitation, which is shining and standing there.
sanskrit_cite: tathāpyāgamarakṣārthaṃ tadagre varṇayiṣyate ukto ya eṣa uccārastatra yo@sau sphuran sthitaḥ

plain_english: The sound-letter, mostly an imitation of the unmanifest, is called the seed of creation and dissolution, and its principal form is known.
sanskrit_cite: avyaktānukṛtiprāyo dhvanirvarṇaḥ sa kathyate sṛṣṭisaṃhārabījaṃ ca tasya mukhyaṃ vapurviduḥ

plain_english: By the power of habit the yogi attains consciousness-nature; likewise in voids with or without seed, from beginning to end, again and again.
sanskrit_cite: tadabhyāsavaśādyāti kramādyogī cidātmatām tathā hyanacke sācke vā kādau sānte punaḥpunaḥ

plain_english: When remembered or uttered, that consciousness arises; external object-convention dependent sounds, such as pot and the like, also arise.
sanskrit_cite: smṛte proccārite vāpi sā sā saṃvitprasūyāte bāhyārthasamayāpekṣā ghaṭādyā dhvanayo@pi ye

plain_english: They too would create object-meditation in the self, like a mind-kingdom; thus the supreme lord said: Bhairava pervades all.
sanskrit_cite: te@pyarthabhāvanāṃ kuryurmanorājyavadātmani taduktaṃ parameśena bhairavo vyāpako@khile

plain_english: Thus, by continuous utterance of the Bhairava word, Shiva; it is also said in the Shri Trika, prior to mantra extraction.
sanskrit_cite: iti bhairavaśabdasya saṃtatoccāraṇācchivaḥ śrīmattraiśirase@pyuktaṃ mantroddhārasya pūrvataḥ

plain_english: Memory is recollection prior; in all beings, truly, it is mantra-nature, causing attainment of that meditated nature.
sanskrit_cite: smṛtiśca smaraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvabhāveṣu vastutaḥ mantrasvarūpaṃ tadbhāvyasvarūpāpattiyojakam

plain_english: Memory produces own-nature; in all beings it colors, by many forms, situated everywhere.
sanskrit_cite: smṛtiḥ svarūpajanikā sarvabhāveṣu rañjikā anekākārarūpeṇa sarvatrāvasthitena tu

plain_english: Attainment of one's own nature is consciousness in ultimate truth; know then manifestation-abiding; that existence is called supreme.
sanskrit_cite: svasvabhāvasya saṃprāptiḥ saṃvittiḥ paramārthataḥ vyaktiniṣṭhā tato viddhi sattā sā kīrtitā parā

plain_english: What then? Without convention, those seed-points throb consciousness, yet they would not lead to consciousness-means.
sanskrit_cite: kiṃ punaḥ samayāpekṣāṃ vinā ye bījapiṇḍakāḥ saṃvidaṃ spandapantyete neyuḥ saṃvidupāyatām

plain_english: Due to absence of the expressible, from the indifferent consciousness-throb of its own abode, by breath-exhilaration and restraint, there is fullness in seed-points.
sanskrit_cite: vācyābhāvādudāsīnasaṃvitspandātsvadhāmataḥ prāṇollāsanirodhābhyāṃ bījapiṇḍeṣu pūrṇatā

plain_english: First consciousness is of bliss-sigh and right equality; feeling indeed is first, the touch of supreme consciousness.
sanskrit_cite: sukhasītkārasatsamyaksāmyaprathamasaṃvidaḥ saṃvedanaṃ hi prathamaṃ sparśo@nuttarasaṃvidaḥ

plain_english: In the heart, throat, and lips, the three abodes, deeply expanding, the fourteenth entry is that which is unified with that self.
sanskrit_cite: hṛtkaṇṭhyoṣṭhyatridhāmāntarnitarāṃ pravikāsini caturdaśaḥ praveśo ya ekīkṛtatadātmakaḥ

plain_english: Then, in the visarga-utterance portion, the devoted chanter leads both paths to the twelve-end together with the heart.
sanskrit_cite: tato visargoccārāṃśe dvādaśāntapathāvubhau hṛdayena sahaikadhyaṃ nayate japatatparaḥ

plain_english: From the end of the kunda process, within the central channel of bliss, vibration brings the seed.
sanskrit_cite: kandahṛtkaṇṭhatālvagrakauṇḍilīprakriyāntataḥ ānandamadhyanāḍyantaḥ spandanaṃ bījamāvahet

plain_english: The dissolution seed is space in the heart, expanded labial form at the head, fire triangle at palate and throat, and bindu situated at the upper place.
sanskrit_cite: saṃhārabījaṃ khaṃ hṛtsthamoṣṭhyaṃ phullaṃ svamūrdhani tejastryaśraṃ tālukaṇṭhe bindurūrdhvapade sthitaḥ

plain_english: By this reasoning, the wise one devoted to letter recitation enters the supreme highest abode quickly.
sanskrit_cite: ityenayā budho yuktyā varṇajapyaparāyaṇaḥ anuttaraṃ paraṃ dhāma praviśedacirāt sudhīḥ

plain_english: By the word letter, blue and so on, or in the dikshottara, one remembers dissolution fire and wind together with Rudra bindu.
sanskrit_cite: varṇaśabdena nīlādi yadvā dīkṣottare yathā saṃhāranragnimaruto rudrabinduyutānsmaret

plain_english: In the heart, the absorbed one sees the target after seven days, variegated like spark fire in blue, yellow, red, and other colors.
sanskrit_cite: hṛdaye tanmayo lakṣyaṃ paśyetsaptadinādatha visphuliṅgāgnivannīlapītaraktādicitritam

plain_english: It blazes in the heart lotus, awakened by the seed lamp; the bindu shines like a lamp, like a dense sun.
sanskrit_cite: jājvalīti hṛdambhoje bījadīpaprabodhitam dīpavajjvalito bindurbhāsate vighanārkavat

plain_english: By this self-luminous self, the one-minded attains identity with Shiva, as copper becomes gold when pierced by mercury.
sanskrit_cite: svayaṃbhāsātmanānena tādātmyaṃ yātyananyadhīḥ śivena hematāṃ yadvattāmraṃ sūtena vedhitam

plain_english: This is an indication; in all mantras one should mark whatever letter net born of resolve, for it is material.
sanskrit_cite: upalakṣaṇametacca sarvamantreṣu lakṣayet yadyatsaṃkalpasaṃbhūtaṃ varṇajālaṃ hi bhautikam

plain_english: That stands as if non-material through excess of consciousness; therefore, rooted in such a form, it grows in consciousness.
sanskrit_cite: tat saṃvidādhikyavaśādabhautikamiva sthitam atastathāvidhe rūpe rūḍho rohati saṃvidi

plain_english: With uncovered form and no condition, the clear-minded sees the unbroken form of consciousness in blue, yellow, pleasure, and pain.
sanskrit_cite: anācchāditarūpāyāmanupādhau prasannadhīḥ nīle pīte sukhe duḥkhe saṃvidrūpamakhaṇḍitam

plain_english: As the gurus have said, therefore variety among the means is shown through utterance, action, meditation, and letters.
sanskrit_cite: gurubhirbhāṣitaṃ tasmādupāyeṣu vicitratā uccārakaraṇadhyānavarṇairebhiḥ pradarśitaḥ

plain_english: The method for attaining the supreme word is thinking nothing, power, and meditation, and that again.
sanskrit_cite: anuttarapadaprāptāvabhyupāyavidhikramaḥ akiṃciccintanaṃ vīryaṃ bhāvanāyāṃ ca sā punaḥ

plain_english: In meditation, utterance, and place-conception, he too should resort to sequence, treating that as external.
sanskrit_cite: dhyāne tadapi coccāre karaṇe so@pi taddhvanau sa sthānakalpane bāhyamiti kramamupāśrayet

plain_english: A supreme yogi who skips sequence without power is like a eunuch or dead body; external and internal conception remains only conceptual.
sanskrit_cite: laṅghanena paro yogī mandabuddhiḥ krameṇa tu vīryaṃ vinā yathā ṣaṇṭhastasyāpyastyatha vā balam mṛtadeha iveyaṃ syādbāhyāntaḥparikalpanā

plain_english: Thus the method of supreme nondual means is declared, by the clear path, as external.
sanskrit_cite: ityāṇave@nuttaratābhyupāyaḥ prokto nayaḥ spaṣṭapathena bāhyaḥ
